assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one isolated PNG game prop for the Aliens (1986) DLC.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target: the published empty five-compartment stainless-steel meal tray. Preserve the tray's outer silhouette, all five pressed wells and their dividers, low frontal three-quarter camera, brushed metal scratches, neutral soft lighting, framing and contact line. Keep the entire tray visible at the same scale.
Change only the contents: add a modest practical Sulaco canteen meal fully contained within the existing wells. Use two small pale translucent rice-paper dumplings with subdued filling, a restrained low golden cornbread portion, and a few muted amber or pale green jellied food pieces. These food types follow a cast member's account of dim sum and jellied sweets used for the Sulaco mess scene; this placement is a gameplay adaptation, not a verified exact plate from the film. Keep some well surfaces visible and all dividers legible. Food must stay low and never alter the outer tray outline.
Style: match the source's detailed realistic matte painted industrial 2D game asset, with restrained neutral reflections. Exactly ONE complete tray per image. Real transparent alpha outside the tray, preserving the existing transparency. No table, floor, cast shadow, halo, smoke, steam, cutlery, cups, hands, extra props, borders, labels, lettering or watermark. Do not turn this into a modern breakfast, a collage or a sprite sheet.

sourceResolutionVisualReview.notes: Five wells, rim, camera and outer silhouette retained; low dumplings, cornbread and jellied portions contained inside wells. Food types follow a cast testimony; exact arrangement is interpretive. No pixel retouching.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent inventory/world-prop PNG sprite for the Aliens (1986) game adaptation.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing grey-green supply case. Preserve its exact recognizable case design, front-and-left three-quarter camera angle seen slightly from above, front black handle, two silver metal toggle latches, reinforced ribs, recessed panels, scuffed grey-green material, neutral lighting and matte realistic illustrated finish. Keep the same body proportions, base width and perspective. Show the whole single case with a small transparent margin on every side, on a 1536 by 1024 landscape canvas. Exactly ONE isolated case, no second view, no sheet, no extra object. This is a functional project adaptation, not a claimed screen-used film prop.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. Remove the source's diffuse background/halo entirely: no opaque background, no floor, no cast shadow outside the case, no fog, no glow, no vignette, no checkerboard painted into the image.
Avoid: random text, numbers, logos, modern equipment, cartridges, tools, extra cargo, cropped corners or handles.
Primary edit: the SAME MEDICAL CASE, now OPEN and visibly completely EMPTY. Its original lid is folded fully backward and LOW/down behind the rear wall of the case, with no upright lid rising above it. The total silhouette must remain low and wide, comparable to the closed reference; the game fits the whole sprite within 76 by 44 units, so do not let a tall lid shrink the main body. Keep the original body and front handle at the same size. Show a clearly hollow empty dark grey-green interior with a visible bare bottom and side walls; no foam inserts, medicine, tools or supplies. Retain the two front metal latches, naturally unhooked for the open state. Preserve ONE clearly legible white cross on the original muted blue medical plaque: because the lid is folded out of view, place that same small plaque on the near outer front wall above the handle, without covering the handle or latches. Do not duplicate the symbol. No lettering or numbers. Keep the base and all lower body edges intact.

Adaptation fonctionnelle du projet.
